title: Пассив: с get, с двумя дополнениями, need doing

why: Вы уже знаете обычный пассив (The email was sent). Здесь три особых случая, которые делают речь естественнее: пассив с get (разговорный, для неожиданных или неприятных событий), пассив с глаголами, у которых два дополнения (give, send, offer), и конструкция need doing («нуждается в ремонте/мытье»). По-русски мы часто говорим «меня уволили», «мне дали», «машину надо помыть», и английский требует для этого отдельных форм.
formation: • пассив с get: get/got + V3 (третья форма): He got fired. They got married. Нет вопросов и отрицаний без do: Did he get fired? He didn't get invited.
Вариант 1 (чаще): человек становится подлежащим: She was offered a job. (be + V3 + вещь)
Вариант 2: вещь становится подлежащим: A job was offered to her. (to + человек)
• need + -ing = need to be + V3 (значение пассивное): The car needs washing = The car needs to be washed.
• get something done (сделать что-то силами других): I got my hair cut. I need to get my laptop repaired.
usage: 1. Get-пассив для случайных, неожиданных, часто неприятных событий в разговорной речи: He got fired last week. (Его уволили на прошлой неделе.) The email got sent to the wrong person. (Письмо ушло не тому человеку.)
2. Get-пассив с действиями, которые человек сам с собой делает или с ним происходят: get married (пожениться), get lost (потеряться), get dressed (одеться), get promoted (получить повышение).

3. Глаголы give, send, offer, show, tell, ask, lend, teach, pay, promise чаще всего ставят в пассиве на первое место человека: I was given a new laptop. (Мне дали новый ноутбук.) We were told the truth. (Нам сказали правду.)
4. Когда важна вещь, а не человек: The wrong files were sent to us. (Нам отправили не те файлы.)
5. Need doing, когда предмет «просит» действия: This code needs rewriting. (Этот код нужно переписать.) Your hair needs cutting. (Тебя пора подстричь.)
signalWords: Get-пассив: accidentally, suddenly, unexpectedly, easily, often (случайно, внезапно, легко). Для need doing: dirty, broken, old, messy (грязный, сломанный, старый, запутанный).
mistakes: ✗ I was been fired yesterday → ✓ I got fired yesterday (get + V3, без дополнительного be)
✗ He was given to me a book → ✓ I was given a book (после be given нет to, если человек подлежащее)
✗ The car needs to wash → ✓ The car needs washing / needs to be washed (смысл пассивный)
✗ The plants need watered → ✓ The plants need watering / need to be watered
✗ I cut my hair at the salon (когда стригли вас) → ✓ I got my hair cut (сами себя вы не стрижёте)
remember: Get + V3 для неожиданного, give/send/offer начинай с человека (I was given), а вещь «нуждается» в -ing: needs fixing.

exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в пассив с get (где возможно, допустим и be)

items.prompt: Be careful on the ice or you ___ (hurt).
items.answer: will get hurt

items.prompt: They ___ (marry) in June.
items.answer: got married

items.prompt: The email ___ (send) to the wrong person.
items.answer: got sent / was sent

items.prompt: Her car ___ (damage) in the parking lot yesterday.
items.answer: got damaged / was damaged

items.prompt: I ___ (lose) on the way to the airport.
items.answer: got lost

items.prompt: We ___ (invite) to the party last Friday.
items.answer: got invited / were invited

items.prompt: The office ___ (clean) every morning.
items.answer: gets cleaned / is cleaned

items.prompt: He ___ (promote) twice last year.
items.answer: got promoted / was promoted

exercises.instruction: Перепишите в пассиве, начиная с человека

items.prompt: They gave me a new laptop.
items.answer: I was given a new laptop.

items.prompt: The manager offered her a job.
items.answer: She was offered a job.

items.prompt: Someone sent us the wrong files.
items.answer: We were sent the wrong files.

items.prompt: They told the students the results.
items.answer: The students were told the results.

items.prompt: The bank lent him some money.
items.answer: He was lent some money.

items.prompt: The company showed the visitors the new office.
items.answer: The visitors were shown the new office.

items.prompt: They asked her a difficult question.
items.answer: She was asked a difficult question.

items.prompt: They will teach us a new method.
items.answer: We will be taught a new method.

exercises.instruction: Перепишите в пассиве, начиная с вещи

items.prompt: They gave me a new laptop.
items.answer: A new laptop was given to me.

items.prompt: Someone offered her a job.
items.answer: A job was offered to her.

items.prompt: They sent us the wrong files.
items.answer: The wrong files were sent to us.

items.prompt: They showed the visitors the office.
items.answer: The office was shown to the visitors.

items.prompt: The school taught the children music.
items.answer: Music was taught to the children.

items.prompt: They promised him a bonus.
items.answer: A bonus was promised to him.

items.prompt: The bank lent him money.
items.answer: Money was lent to him.

items.prompt: Somebody wrote her a letter.
items.answer: A letter was written to her.

exercises.instruction: Need doing и get something done

items.prompt: The car is dirty. It needs ___ (wash).
items.answer: washing / to be washed

items.prompt: Your hair is too long. It needs ___ (cut).
items.answer: cutting / to be cut

items.prompt: The code is a mess. It needs ___ (refactor).
items.answer: refactoring / to be refactored

items.prompt: Rewrite with need + -ing: This shirt must be ironed.
items.answer: This shirt needs ironing.

items.prompt: Rewrite with need to be + V3: The windows need cleaning.
items.answer: The windows need to be cleaned.

items.prompt: I need to get my passport ___ (renew) before the trip.
items.answer: renewed

items.prompt: Correct the mistake: The bug needs to fix.
items.answer: The bug needs fixing. / The bug needs to be fixed.

items.prompt: Correct the mistake: The plants need watered.
items.answer: The plants need watering. / The plants need to be watered.

items.prompt: Меня уволили в прошлом месяце.
items.answer: I got fired last month. / I was fired last month.

items.prompt: Мне дали новый ноутбук.
items.answer: I was given a new laptop. / A new laptop was given to me.

items.prompt: Моей машине нужен ремонт.
items.answer: My car needs repairing. / My car needs to be repaired.

items.prompt: Им не сказали правду.
items.answer: They weren't told the truth.

items.prompt: Мне нужно подстричься.
items.answer: I need to get a haircut. / I need to get my hair cut.

items.prompt: Нас пригласили на конференцию.
items.answer: We got invited to the conference. / We were invited to the conference.

items.prompt: Этот код нужно переписать.
items.answer: This code needs rewriting. / This code needs to be rewritten.

items.prompt: Ей предложили новую должность.
items.answer: She was offered a new position. / She was offered a new job.
